verses.sanskrit:
वेदान्तवाक्येषु सदा रमन्तो
भिक्षान्नमात्रेण च तुष्टिमन्तः ।
विशोकमन्तःकरणे चरन्तः
कौपीनवन्तः खलु भाग्यवन्तः ॥ १॥
verses.roman:
vedāntavākyeṣu sadā ramanto
bhikṣānnamātreṇa ca tuṣṭimantaḥ .
viśokamantaḥkaraṇe carantaḥ
kaupīnavantaḥ khalu bhāgyavantaḥ .. 1..
verses.colloquial:
vedaantavaakyeshu sadaa ramanto
bhikshaannamaatrena cha tushtimantah .
vishokamantahkarane charantah
kaupiinavantah khalu bhaagyavantah .. 1..
verses.translation_reworded:
Always moving among the truths of Vedanta,
always content with the scraps he receives as a beggar,
wandering on with a heart untouched by grief,
how fortunate is the one who wears only a loincloth.

verses.sanskrit:
मूलं तरोः केवलमाश्रयन्तः
पाणिद्वयं भोक्तुममन्त्रयन्तः ।
कन्थामिव श्रीमपि कुत्सयन्तः
कौपीनवन्तः खलु भाग्यवन्तः ॥ २॥
verses.roman:
mūlaṃ taroḥ kevalamāśrayantaḥ
pāṇidvayaṃ bhoktumamantrayantaḥ .
kanthāmiva śrīmapi kutsayantaḥ
kaupīnavantaḥ khalu bhāgyavantaḥ .. 2..
verses.colloquial:
muulam taroh kevalamaashrayantah
paanidvayam bhoktumamantrayantah .
kanthaamiva shriimapi kutsayantah
kaupiinavantah khalu bhaagyavantah .. 2..
verses.translation_reworded:
Taking shelter at the base of a tree,
eating his small share from his own hands,
tossing aside wealth as if it were a torn rag,
how fortunate is the one who wears only a loincloth.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वानन्दभावे परितुष्टिमन्तः
सुशान्तसर्वेन्द्रियवृत्तिमन्तः ।
अहर्निशं ब्रह्मसुखे रमन्तः
कौपीनवन्तः खलु भाग्यवन्तः ॥ ३॥
verses.roman:
svānandabhāve parituṣṭimantaḥ
suśāntasarvendriyavṛttimantaḥ .
aharniśaṃ brahmasukhe ramantaḥ
kaupīnavantaḥ khalu bhāgyavantaḥ .. 3..
verses.colloquial:
svaanandabhaave paritushtimantah
sushaantasarvendriyavrittimantah .
aharnisham brahmasukhe ramantah
kaupiinavantah khalu bhaagyavantah .. 3..
verses.translation_reworded:
Completely content with the Bliss inside him,
holding every craving of the senses in check,
rejoicing day and night in the bliss of Brahman,
how fortunate is the one who wears only a loincloth.

verses.sanskrit:
देहादिभावं परिवर्तयन्तः
स्वात्मानमात्मन्यवलोकयन्तः ।
नान्तं न मध्यं न बहिः स्मरन्तः
कौपीनवन्तः खलु भाग्यवन्तः ॥ ४॥
verses.roman:
dehādibhāvaṃ parivartayantaḥ
svātmānamātmanyavalokayantaḥ .
nāntaṃ na madhyaṃ na bahiḥ smarantaḥ
kaupīnavantaḥ khalu bhāgyavantaḥ .. 4..
verses.colloquial:
dehaadibhaavam parivartayantah
svaatmaanamaatmanyavalokayantah .
naantam na madhyam na bahih smarantah
kaupiinavantah khalu bhaagyavantah .. 4..
verses.translation_reworded:
Watching the shifting states of mind and body,
seeing nothing except the Self within,
unconcerned with outer, inner, or in-between,
how fortunate is the one who wears only a loincloth.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्माक्षरं पावनमुच्चरन्तो
ब्रह्माहमस्मीति विभावयन्तः ।
भिक्षाशिनो दिक्षु परिभ्रमन्तः
कौपीनवन्तः खलु भाग्यवन्तः ॥ ५॥
verses.roman:
brahmākṣaraṃ pāvanamuccaranto
brahmāhamasmīti vibhāvayantaḥ .
bhikṣāśino dikṣu paribhramantaḥ
kaupīnavantaḥ khalu bhāgyavantaḥ .. 5..
verses.colloquial:
brahmaaksharam paavanamuccharanto
brahmaahamasmiiti vibhaavayantah .
bhikshaashino dikshu paribhramantah
kaupiinavantah khalu bhaagyavantah .. 5..
verses.translation_reworded:
Repeating Brahman, the word that sets one free,
meditating on nothing but "I am Brahman,"
living on alms and roaming wherever he will,
how fortunate is the one who wears only a loincloth.
